resources.string: Save a backup, restore one, back up automatically, or share workouts with friends

One file with everything in the app: exercises with their photos and videos, workouts, history, variations, AI notes and the AI spend log. AI keys are never included; after restoring on another phone, enter them again.

When you leave the app and the last backup is a day old, a new one is saved to a folder you choose, for example one your cloud drive syncs. The newest %1$d are kept; older ones the app made are deleted.
The last backup failed (%1$s): the app can no longer reach the folder. Choose it again.
The last backup failed (%1$s): the file couldn\'t be written. Check that there is free space.
Send workouts and exercises, with their photos and videos, as a file. Your history and personal notes stay with you. A friend opens it here with \"Import a friend\'s file\".
